feature_pipeline_version: Model C (Geometry v2 + Occlusion Aware Proxies)

hand_0_wrist_relative_coords.description: 21 3D landmarks centered at wrist and normalized by palm scale (||mid_mcp - wrist||)

hand_0_internal_geometry.description: Normalized distances, angles, curl ratios, palm normal, bounding span

hand_1_internal_geometry.description: Internal geometry features for Hand 1 (zero-padded for 1-hand signs)

inter_hand_features.description: Wrist distance, 3D displacement, fingertip contact distances, normal alignment

occlusion_and_contact_proxies.description: Hand presence one-hot, 2D bbox IoU, signed depth offset, palm contact, cross cosines

translation_invariance.mechanism: All landmark coordinates centered at pts[WRIST] before scaling; inter-hand features compute relative differences

scale_invariance.mechanism: All distances divided by palm scale ||pts[MID_MCP] - pts[WRIST]||

rotation_invariance_3d.details: Dims 0-62 and 125-187 (126 features, 43.58% total model importance) are raw (x,y,z) relative coordinates in camera space. When a signer tilts their hand or the camera angle changes, coordinates rotate across tree decision boundaries trained on signer_01 and signer_04.

perspective_invariance.details: MediaPipe extracts landmarks from 2D pixel projections. A 15° lateral rotation causes finger self-occlusion (H->G) and foreshortening.

handedness_ordering_invariance.details: Multi-hand processing sorts hands by horizontal screen coordinate (wrist_x). One-hand signs always place active hand in Hand 0. If a resting lap hand is misidentified as active and sits to the left of the signing hand, the resting hand becomes Hand 0 and the signing hand becomes Hand 1, completely inverting the feature vector.

verified_pipeline_findings.description: 43.58% of Random Forest feature importance relies on un-rotated 3D coordinate features (dims 0-62 and 125-187). These features are not canonicalized to the palm coordinate frame (e.g., wrist-to-middle-MCP axis and palm normal plane).
Sorting by screen wrist_x instead of anatomical handedness causes catastrophic Hand 0 / Hand 1 channel inversion whenever a secondary hand is detected to the left of the signing hand.

Lap-hand suppression threshold in select_active_hands requires wrist distance >= 0.35. Signer_05 resting hand in Condition 2 exhibited wrist distance = 0.31, preventing suppression and generating false two-handed signs for L and T.
Rescaling from 640x360 to native coordinates has zero effect on geometry features because MediaPipe outputs normalized [0.0, 1.0] coordinates.
